errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no group state for this room.
`member` has no leaf in the group.
`member` is the recipient's own leaf. A key holder does not remove itself; an owner leaving a room hands it on with rooms/owner/transfer.
The recipient holds no authority credential conferring `admin` on this room for its caller, so it cannot advance the room's epoch at the host.
The host is at a different epoch than the recipient's group — another admin advanced the room. Catch up (rooms/epoch/commits) and try again. The host's epoch is carried in `details.hostEpoch`.

The named host could not be resolved, advertises no transport this recipient speaks, or did not answer. The outcome is unknown — the host may have accepted the advance — so the recipient keeps the pending removal and the next request to it settles it (item 6).
The host answered and declined the epoch advance. Its reason is carried in `details`. Nothing was changed.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Group Remove — response payload

host.description: The room's host, as a DID: where the room's epoch advances.

member.description: The DID whose leaf is removed. Never the recipient's own leaf.

reason.description: Why, carried to the host's epoch advance. Untrusted and attributed to its author: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

roomId.description: The room whose group loses a member. The recipient MUST hold its group.
